'''Martha Harms''' is a voice actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}. She is currently affiliated with the Mary Collins Agency in Texas and Buchwald in New York.

==Biography==
Harms was born on July 24, 1986 in Elm Grove, Wisconsin, United States. She joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|SM}}, where she gained a major recurring role as [[Officer Jenny]] starting in [[SM070]].
